g.text: One DSpark drafting round in V4.1-Flash (block size 5)
target model, decode step for the current token
drafter input: anchor token + 4 noise tokens (shared embedding)
Markov head, left to right (rank 256): bias from the previous sampled token
confidence head: c_k = sigmoid(w . [h_k ; W_1[x_{k-1}]]), survival a_k = c_1 * ... * c_k
Five draft tokens per round for one drafter pass plus five cheap sequential corrections. The survival scores go to the scheduler, which decides how many of the five to verify.
Drafter weights ship in the checkpoint under 'mtp.'; trained after backbone pre-training with the backbone frozen. Confidence values are illustrative.
